exercises.title: Escape the double jump
exercises.instruction: Black's numbered route threatens two white men. Move the first threatened man out of that route.

feedback.initial: The arrows show what Black could capture if given the turn here. You move first: break the route before it begins.
feedback.selected: Move the first target to a square outside Black's capture diagonal.
feedback.success: You moved the first target away. Black cannot start the jump, so both threatened men survive.
feedback.goalMiss: For this exercise, rescue the first target. Moving the rear man away still lets Black take the advanced man; blocking is another defense you will practice next.
feedback.invalidPiece: Select the first white man on Black's route.
feedback.invalidDestination: Choose a legal forward diagonal step.

exercises.title: Block the landing
exercises.instruction: White threatens a double jump. Move Black's rear man onto White's first landing square to save both targets.

threat.label: WHITE'S THREAT — DENY THE FIRST LANDING

feedback.initial: An attacker needs an empty landing. Occupy the square marked 1 with Black's rear man.
feedback.selected: Use the rear man to deny White's first landing.
feedback.success: Your defender occupies White's landing. White has no capture, so neither black target is lost.
feedback.goalMiss: Use the rear man to block the first landing. Moving it to the other diagonal leaves the advanced man exposed.
feedback.invalidPiece: Choose Black's rear man on the capture route.
feedback.invalidDestination: Choose a legal forward diagonal step.

exercises.title: Keep the blocker
exercises.instruction: The middle white man already blocks Black's landing. Move another man safely while keeping that protection.

threat.label: IF THE MIDDLE BLOCKER MOVES, THIS ROUTE OPENS

feedback.initial: This is a conditional route: Black cannot jump while the first landing is occupied. Do not remove that blocker.
feedback.selected: Check the departure square as well as the destination.
feedback.success: You moved a target and preserved the middle blocker. Black still has no capture.
feedback.goalMiss: That move vacates Black's landing and exposes two teammates. Keep the middle blocker and move another man.

exercises.title: Stop the king's route
exercises.instruction: Black's king can choose either two-jump branch. Move a white piece to stop both routes without losing a target.

feedback.initial: Both branches share the first target and landing. Remove that target or block that landing to stop the whole threat.
feedback.selected: Kings can turn and jump backward. Your defense must stop every branch.
feedback.success: The king has no capture. Your move stopped both branches instead of protecting only one second target.
feedback.goalMiss: That move leaves a capture available. Stop the shared first jump by removing its target or occupying its landing.
feedback.invalidDestination: Choose a legal forward diagonal step.

exercises.title: Don't trust a late recapture
exercises.instruction: Black would take two men before your back-row supporter could recapture one attacker. Break the route and avoid that loss.

threat.label: TWO MEN LOST BEFORE ONE ATTACKER IS RECAPTURED

feedback.initial: The supporter cannot interrupt Black's turn. Losing two men and recovering one is a net loss of one. Prevent the jumps instead.
feedback.selected: Move the first target or block the first landing.
feedback.success: Black has no capture. You saved both men rather than relying on a recapture that comes too late.
feedback.goalMiss: That move still permits a capture. Save both targets by removing the first target or blocking the first landing.
feedback.invalidDestination: Choose a legal forward diagonal step.
